hooks.description: Runs node --check on the saved frontend file so a syntax slip never reaches the deployed static bundle. The helper reads the saved file path from the hook's STDIN context JSON.
hooks.name: Syntax-check saved frontend JS

action.prompt: The spec task just finished. Update .kiro/specs/revenant/tasks.md (tick the completed task) and, if the implementation diverged from design.md, record the change in the design.md decision log before moving on.

hooks.description: After a spec task completes, prompts the agent to tick the task in tasks.md and record any design change in design.md, keeping the spec honest.
hooks.name: Remind to update the spec tasks
